components.css: .ds-item { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e7e2d9; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 14px 16px; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-item:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-item-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .ds-rank { flex: none; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #6b655a; } .ds-item-link { font-weight: 500; color: #1c1a17; text-decoration: none; word-break: break-word; } .ds-item-link:hover { color: #b4540a; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-badge-new { flex: none; align-self: center; border: 1px solid rgba(180,84,10,0.3); background: rgba(180,84,10,0.1); color: #b4540a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-item-body { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b655a; } .ds-chips { margin-top: 10px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip-metric { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid #e7e2d9; background: #faf8f4; color: #6b655a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-chip-metric strong { font-weight: 600; color: #1c1a17; } .ds-chip-tag { border: 1px solid rgba(180,84,10,0.25); background: rgba(180,84,10,0.1); color: #b4540a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.7rem; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: iOS-style segmented control with a sliding Burnt Sienna indicator. Active segment text flips to white.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; display: flex; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e7e2d9; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px; } .ds-seg-ind { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc(50% - 4px); background: #b4540a; border-radius: 9999px; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 0; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6b655a; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-seg-active { color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: Morning Brief is a daily intelligence briefing rendered as a native iOS app. The substance is editorial — a curated, ranked, opinionated read on AI, startups, open source, and research — but the vehicle is a phone app, not a web page. A bottom tab bar owns navigation; panels are sections of a briefing, not scrollable feeds. Type carries the authority of a well-set morning paper (Newsreader serif over warm paper) while interaction carries native momentum: sliding segmented indicators, springy tap feedback, safe-area awareness. The system is deliberately flat and quiet so the content can be sharp — depth comes from white surfaces on warm paper and hairline borders, never heavy shadow. One signal color, Burnt Sienna, does all the pointing.
keyCharacteristics: Native-app interaction model: bottom tab bar, segmented controls, tap feedback.
Warm paper ground (#faf8f4), not cold white or cream-tinted near-white.
One accent only — Burnt Sienna — spent sparingly on signal.
Editorial serif/sans pairing: Newsreader display, Inter body.
Flat by default; depth via borders and tone, not shadow.
Finite and calm: a complete morning read with a clear top and bottom.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Burnt Sienna appears on ≤10% of any screen and only on things that are actionable or genuinely new. A second element wanting emphasis gets weight or size, not color.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: Text is never #000. Ink is #1c1a17 — black pulled toward the paper's hue — so the page reads as printed, not backlit.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label appears exactly once per view — the date over the headline. Section titles are serif headlines, never eyebrows.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If an element needs to feel raised, give it the white surface fill and a line border, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Tactile-Press Rule
rules.body: Because the system is flat at rest, motion carries tactility. Pressables scale to ~0.985 on :active — the only transform surfaces are allowed.

dos: Do keep Burnt Sienna (#b4540a) to ≤10% of any screen, only on actionable or genuinely-new elements.
Do convey depth with the white-surface-on-paper tonal step plus a 1px line border.
Do make taps feel physical: :active scale ~0.985, sliding segmented indicators, color transitions ≤200ms ease-out.
Do respect the device: safe-area insets, native <select> for the day picker, tab-bar navigation, a reading column near 680px.
Do set headlines in Newsreader with text-wrap: balance; set working text in Inter ≤75ch.
Do use tabular figures for ranks, metrics, and any aligned number column.
Do give every transition a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback.
donts: Don't build the generic SaaS dashboard: no identical card grids, no gradient hero-metrics, no purple-blue startup palette.
Don't drift toward the cluttered news portal: no thumbnail walls, no ad slots, no infinite scroll.
Don't adopt social-feed chrome: no vanity like-counts, no engagement-bait.
Don't touch the crypto/AI-hype aesthetic: no neon glow, no dark-by-default, no glassmorphism-as-decoration.
Don't add drop shadows; if it needs to lift, it gets a border and a tonal step.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe on cards or items.
Don't scatter uppercase tracked eyebrows above sections — there is exactly one, the date masthead.
Don't introduce a second accent color for emphasis; reach for weight or size.
